يكتتبون (form VIII)
# يَكْتَتِبُونَ (yaktatibūna) /jak.ta.ti.buː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِكْتَتَبَ (iktataba)
# يُكْتَتَبُونَ (yuktatabūna) /juk.ta.ta.buː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِكْتَتَبَ (iktataba)
